data.title: bn-1u8: Add an effects-rich Operation Lilybreaker tracker mix
data.description: Review the committed standalone tracker mix and generator for musical/channel design, Console format correctness, reproducibility, documentation accuracy, and regressions. Focused music lint is clean and just check passes.

data.body: LOW: The five tactical brass gaps are applied only after every voice/pair has already been interned, so four unique brass phrases remain defined but unreachable. A reference scan finds 60 defined SFX versus 56 referenced, with IDs 33, 35, 37, and 40 unused. Since this format has a hard 64-ID budget and the documentation discusses gameplay integration/headroom, skip gap phrases before interning (or compact/remap after slot removal) and update the stated ID count. This would preserve the exact rendered mix while recovering four IDs.

Fixed: the five brass gaps now skip interning before ID assignment. The generated cart drops from 60 to 56 defined SFX, strict lint stays at zero diagnostics, and a seeded 64-second render is byte-identical (SHA-256 070ce1f7...). Documentation now reports the compacted count.

data.reason: Verified c7746a9: all 56 defined SFX are referenced, generated cart is reproducible, strict lint is clean, and the seeded 64-second WAV is byte-identical to the pre-compaction render.
